question.wording: Was this state or local income tax actually paid (or withheld) during 2025?

options.label: Yes — paid in 2025 (including a 2024 balance or an estimate paid in 2025)

default.because: A tax on the 2025 record was paid in 2025 unless a preparer says otherwise

citation.wording: State and local income taxes paid in 2025 for a prior year, such as taxes paid with your 2024 state or local income tax return.
